name: Clef-omni
summary: Classify text, images, audio, and video in one API call to build media tagging or moderation tools. Download the open weights or use the hosted API at $0.15 per million input tokens.

name: LightOnOCR-3
summary: Turn PDFs and scans into text, labeled page sections, image descriptions, and chart data. Try the browser demo or download the models to build document tools, with an Apache 2.0 license that allows commercial use.

name: Claude Docs, Slides, and Design
summary: Create documents, slide decks, and designs directly in a Claude conversation, now on every plan including Free. Edit them on your phone and export decks to PowerPoint, PDF, or editable Google Slides.

name: GPT-6 + Intelligent UI
summary: Get answers as interactive charts, calculators, forms, and buttons instead of plain text. It is rolling out to every ChatGPT tier, with GPT-6 Sol on paid plans and GPT-6 Luna on Free and Go.

name: Claude Haiku 5.5
summary: Power live customer support, quick summaries, and small coding tasks with a fast, low-cost model. It is available through the Claude API and major clouds, with average costs roughly 75% below Haiku 4.5.

name: Google AI Edge Foresight
summary: Turn meeting audio and shorthand into polished notes, then ask questions across your notes and project files. This experimental Mac app runs its AI offline and is optimized for Apple silicon, without a cloud subscription.

name: Rill Browser
summary: Turn a webpage into a coding task for Claude Code or Codex without leaving your browser. The free Mac beta uses your existing plan and requires Apple silicon with macOS 14 or later.

name: EmbeddingGemma 2
summary: Add on-device search across text, code, images, audio, and video with one small open model. It runs in under 600 MB of RAM, downloads free from Hugging Face, and its Apache 2.0 license allows commercial use.
